$comment: LIFX LAN messages worked out by hand from https://lan.developer.lifx.com/docs (header: size u16, protocol 1024 | addressable 0x1000 | tagged 0x2000 as u16, source u32, target 8 bytes = MAC + 00 00, 6 reserved, flags (res/ack) = 00, sequence, 8 reserved, type u16, 2 reserved; little endian), not by running the plugin. Source 0x6B656468 -> 68 64 65 6B. Untagged byte 3 = 0x14, tagged = 0x34. Bulb MAC d0:73:d5:01:02:03. SetColor (102 = 0x66) payload: reserved 00, hue, saturation, brightness, kelvin (u16 each), duration u32; kelvin 3500 = 0x0DAC -> AC 0D; duration 50 ms = 32 00 00 00. Hue: degrees * 65535 / 360: red 0 -> 0000, green 120 -> 21845 = 0x5555, blue 240 -> 43690 = 0xAAAA. Brightness max/255 * 65535: 255 -> FFFF, 128 -> 32896 = 0x8080. SetLightPower (117 = 0x75) payload: level u16, duration u32. Sizes: 36 + payload (Get 0 -> 0x24, SetLightPower 6 -> 0x2A, SetColor 13 -> 0x31). Device sequence starts at 0 (Get), 1 (SetLightPower), 2 (first SetColor). Service sequence starts at 1 (first GetService), then 2 (GetLabel) and 3 (GetVersion).
